headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences on ₹600 crore preferential allotment of warrants
sum: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited has made a preferential allotment of fully convertible warrants aggregating to approximately ₹600 crore in favour of Promoters Dr. Abhinay Bollineni and Mr.
detail: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited has made a preferential allotment of fully convertible warrants aggregating to approximately ₹600 crore in favour of Promoters Dr. Abhinay Bollineni and Mr. Adwik Bollineni and Promoter Group Bharas Ventures LLP. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences on this transaction.
